title: First-row decomposition of the row sum
statement: Let $t$ be a bit, let $a,b$ be finite bit strings, and let $j,p$ be nonnegative integers. Define the sum of rows by summing, over positions $q$ in the first string, the row sum formed from its bit at $q$ and the second string, at indices $j,p+q$, treating a missing bit as $0$. The sum of rows for the string formed by placing $t$ before $a$ equals the row sum for $t,b$ at indices $j,p$, plus the sum of rows for $a,b$ at indices $j,p+1$.
